SELECT cls, COUNT(*) trips, SUM(anglers) anglers, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 220 AND 244
GROUP BY cls ORDER BY ypa DESC

SELECT boat, cls, COUNT(*) trips, SUM(anglers) anglers, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 220 AND 244 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
GROUP BY boat, cls HAVING COUNT(*)>=3 ORDER BY ypa DESC LIMIT 15
